annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/1130 correcting the Dutch language version of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2025/1130 correcting the Dutch language version of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Delegated Regulation correcting an error in the Dutch language version of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems, specifically a class C6 requirement. Other language versions are unaffected. It is a purely linguistic correction and enters into force on the twentieth day after publication.
key_provisions_or_claims: Corrects the Dutch version of Annex part 17, third paragraph, point 3 of Delegated Regulation 2019/945 (class C6 UAS).
Other language versions are not affected.
Enters into force on the twentieth day after publication in the Official Journal.
Binding in its entirety and directly applicable in all Member States.
